QuestInfo.name: [Rose Garden] Imprisoned Souls
QuestInfo.0: Cecilia in the Rose Garden has another request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat Keymaster Rousseau to get #bRousseau's Key#k, and then click the #bImprisoned Souls#k to free them. Pick up 5 #bFreed Soul Crystals#k to give to Cecilia.

0.0: Do you know who I really feel bad for? The kids. So many children got caught in the war and chaos. They didn't deserve that, and yet they got the worst of it.
0.1: You see, The #bsouls of the children#k are still tied to this place. Pretty messed up, right?
0.2: We need to get rid of #bKeymaster Rousseau#k if we want to free them. Get Rousseau's Key and then click the #bimprisoned souls#k to free them. Grab 5 #bFreed Soul Crystals#k to finish the job. Easy, right?

yes.0: I appreciate this. It would warm my heart if...y'know.\r\n#b(Head to where the souls are imprisoned. Click the souls with Rousseau's Key in your inventory to get the crystals.)#k

no.0: Okay, I have no idea how you can refuse to release the tormented souls of children. Seriously, listen to yourself.

yes.0: Well, I feel much better. Less sad souls hanging around now.

default.0: Eliminate Keymaster Rousseau and get Rousseau's Key. With the key in your inventory, you can click the imprisoned souls to free them. Collect 5 Freed Soul Crystals to complete the job. Easy, right?
